beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: That shifts political pressure toward what becomes visible enough to count.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The reading experience joins an economic transformation to everyday negotiations over a shared world.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Start with The Last Price and its motionless, urgently needed shipment.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Then compare the later city where buying no longer organizes ordinary access.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The contrast explains why this is a novel about power as well as abundance.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its appeal is the concrete life of choices that an economic slogan leaves unresolved.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Readers can follow how a need becomes a claim on shared capacity.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book makes the disappearance of prices the beginning of an inquiry.
